mapper.select: SELECT uid,status FROM user WHERE openid=#{openid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appeal WHERE uid=#{uid} AND status='待处理' AND ct >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appeal WHERE uid=#{uid} AND ct >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)
SELECT aid,uid,status FROM appeal WHERE aid=#{aid} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE appeal SET status=#{status},handler=#{handler},hct=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,reason=#{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE aid=#{aid} AND status='待处理'
UPDATE user SET status='正常' WHERE uid=#{uid}
